objective: Write the ticket for the factory from the conversation into artifacts/<task id>.md (or, for an investigation, the report); change no code.
acceptance: The ticket stands alone for an agent that never saw the conversation.
«Рішення» holds only what the manager said; everything else is listed as not decided.
It says what is expected, in plain words, not how to change the code; any hint about the code is short, checked, and marked as a hint.
